accounting.entry: open of the first 5-min bar starting after the signal bar closes; skip if that open is beyond stop or target
accounting.exit: 15:55 bar close if no barrier hit
accounting.dedupe: one position per ticker-day; no re-entry after exit

decision_metric: net avgR in own-R units (and net pnl_pct per trade); excess over the universe's own random-bar / all-watchlist benchmark

pass_criteria_TEST.multiple_testing: Holm across the whole family listed below (11 rule x structure cells)

U1_inplay_intraday.universe: US common stocks (nasdaqtrader lists, ex ETFs/warrants/units/preferreds), prev close >= $5, ADV20 dollar >= $20M; DAILY WATCHLIST = names with ex-ante gap (RTH open vs prior close) >= +3%, ranked by gap%, top 20 per day; gap-downs excluded for longs
U1_inplay_intraday.data: bars5m_inplay (60d, prepost) + bars1d_all; watchlist from inplay_candidates.csv (ex-ante fields only: gap_pct, prev_close, adv20_dollar)
U1_inplay_intraday.exploration_disclosure: DISC-only base rates were inspected on 2026-09-13 (12 slices: all/up/down, gap>=5/8, above open, holding gap, 09:35-10:00 vs 10:05-11:00, ADV<>$100M). No TEST data has been read. Thresholds below were chosen from those DISC looks; family size counts them.

structures.S_a_scanner: stop = entry - 2xATR14(5m, RTH+PM frame as scanner), target = +2.5R
structures.S_b_orlow: stop = min(day low so far at signal, entry*(1-0.01)) i.e. opening-range/day low with a 1% floor; no target; exit 15:55

rules.R0_benchmark_all_watchlist_1005: buy every watchlist name at the 10:05 bar open (structures S_a and S_b). This is the universe base rate / benchmark for excess.
rules.R1_gap_and_hold_1005: at the close of the 10:00 bar: price > RTH open AND price > session VWAP (from 04:00) AND price >= 0.5% above RTH open; enter 10:05 open; structures S_a, S_b
rules.R2_first_vwap_pullback: between 10:00 and 12:00, the FIRST bar whose low <= session VWAP and close > VWAP and close > open; enter next bar open; S_a with stop = pullback bar low - 0.25xATR14; S_b variant: stop = pullback low, no target
rules.R3_orb15: first close above the 09:30-09:45 range high, after 09:45 and before 11:00, with close > VWAP; enter next bar open; stop = OR low (floor 1%); target +2R (S_a-like) and no-target (S_b)
rules.R4_small_cap_tilt: R1 restricted to ADV20 dollar in [$20M, $100M) with 10 bp/side

benchmarks: random watchlist bar in the same 15-min bucket on the same day

U2_static_control_arm.universe: current 211-name scanner universe; current live picks from picks_master (post-06-17)

rules.C1: fixed K=10/day first-come, no entries 12:00-13:00, stop floor 0.6%, dedupe
rules.C2: C1 + opening-tape gate (SPY and QQQ above prior close at 09:35) as beta management

U2_static_control_arm.purpose: the 'do less harm' baseline; NOT expected to be positive; reported per-capital with K=10

U3_multiday_swing.universe: bars1d_all: US common stocks, prev close >= $5, ADV20 dollar >= $50M (2,814 names with 2y daily bars); survivorship caveat: list is as of 2026-09-13
U3_multiday_swing.accounting: enter at next day's OPEN after the signal close (T+1 open), exit at close of holding day; 10 bp per side; max 10 concurrent positions, equal risk; benchmark = SPY over the same holding window (excess return)

rules.W1_gap_continuation_3d: signal day: gap >= +5%, close in top third of day range, volume >= 2x ADV20; hold 3 sessions
rules.W2_breakout_rs_5d: close > prior 20-day high AND 20d return > SPY 20d return AND close > MA50; hold 5 sessions; max 10 new entries/day ranked by 20d RS
rules.W3_big_gap_drift_5d: gap >= +8% AND volume >= 3x ADV20 AND close > open; hold 5 sessions
rules.W0_benchmark: all names with gap >= +3% held 3 sessions (universe base rate)

U3_multiday_swing.pass_criteria: mean net excess return over SPY per trade > 0 with quarter-cluster CI > 0 AND positive in >= 6 of 8 quarters; n >= 300 trades

not_to_be_run: any exit/stop/target/trail/time-stop sweep on current picks
any payload re-weighting or ML on current payload
things_tried_log: validators must append every additional variant they evaluate to research/things_tried.csv with window and result
